## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. State any relevant checks not run.

## Limitations

Note compatibility changes, remaining limitations, or follow-up work, if any.

## Before merging

- [ ] This PR targets `main` from a separate branch.
- [ ] The change is focused and contains no credentials or private run artifacts.
- [ ] Documentation reflects user-visible changes, where applicable.
- [ ] Review conversations are resolved.

Merge using **Squash and merge**; the PR requirement applies to maintainers and
the repository owner as well as external contributors.
